title: HTRANS: Valid Burst and Suspicious Restart
description: Compare a legal NONSEQ–SEQ burst containing BUSY with a buggy sequence that resumes using SEQ after leaving the burst.

annotations.message: NONSEQ marks the first valid beat of both bursts.
SEQ is legal because it continues the burst started by NONSEQ.
BUSY inserts no transfer but preserves the valid burst context; address progression resumes afterward.
The valid sequence resumes with SEQ after BUSY. The buggy sequence used IDLE, so its next valid beat must restart with NONSEQ.

violations.message: BUGGY HTRANS uses SEQ after IDLE. No active burst remains, so this transfer must be NONSEQ.
